en.frame_note: Analytical teaching frame · not measured data
en.gas_intro: Follow the mean energy and the fraction of the initial departure from equilibrium that remains. The cursor reports physical residence time.
en.gas_time_note: Early-relaxation mode uses nonuniform playback timing. The displayed time and model values remain physical.
en.gas_pdf_toggle: Show an illustrative Maxwell energy distribution
en.gas_pdf_assumption: Additional illustration assumption: a three-dimensional Maxwell energy distribution at every frame, with kT_eff = 2⟨E⟩/3. The relaxation model calculates only the mean; it does not establish this distribution. Curves are separately normalized to peak = 1; the log-spaced energy axis retains physical energy labels.
en.gas_pdf_zero: At zero mean energy the ideal distribution is a delta function; a finite-width curve is not defined.
en.gas_zero_rate: No relaxation: the pressure or energy-transfer efficiency is zero. The mean energy stays at its initial value.
en.gas_at_equilibrium: The initial mean already equals thermal equilibrium.
en.gas_model_note: Exponential mean-energy relaxation in a uniform gas with a fixed initial relative-speed estimate. This scene does not calculate individual collisions, RF heating or transmission.
en.gas_step1_body: n = p/(kBT) and ν = nσv_rel. Raising pressure increases this model’s encounter rate, while the cross section and relative speed remain prescribed.
en.gas_step2_body: The transferred energy fraction is 2mM/(m+M)², multiplied by your efficiency factor. Many encounters may be needed for one energy relaxation time.
en.gas_step3_title: 3. The mean approaches a thermal level
en.gas_step3_body: The initial energy departure decreases as exp(−t/τ). One τ leaves 36.8%; five τ leave 0.674%. RF heating can alter the physical equilibrium but is outside this model.
en.bunch_intro: Move an observation plane through a field-free drift. Higher-energy ions arrive earlier, so a positive initial time–energy correlation can compress the time projection.
en.bunch_projection_title: Time projections on the same scale
en.bunch_beamline_note: Schematic: source covariance is supplied; no extraction waveform or fringe field is solved.
en.bunch_contour_note: The ellipse is a covariance contour, not an ion trajectory. The shown radius of 2 encloses 86.5% for a two-dimensional Gaussian. Drift applies Δt → Δt + gΔE and leaves ΔE unchanged.
en.bunch_projection_note: Both Gaussian projections use the same time axis and are separately normalized to peak = 1. Widths follow the first-order covariance model; peak heights do not represent ion counts.
en.bunch_preset_note: Compression sets ρ = +0.95 and chooses the drift that minimizes the first-order width for that correlation. Broadening sets ρ = −0.85; the other source inputs remain yours.
en.bunch_near_focus: Near a first-order time focus: neglected second-order drift spread is significant. A narrow linear contour is not a validated detector peak.
en.bunch_large_spread: The energy spread exceeds the linearization screening limit. Treat this frame as a formal first-order illustration.
en.bunch_degenerate: A zero-width projection is shown as a delta line; finite source and higher-order effects are not supplied by this model.
en.bunch_inventory_note: These are expectations from the separate accumulation/loss model and your extraction fraction; no space-charge or pulser trajectory calculation is implied.
en.bunch_step1_body: The input standard deviations and correlation define Cov(t,E) = ρ σt σE. Positive correlation means later ions tend to carry higher energy.
en.bunch_step2_body: For mean energy E and flight time T, g = dT/dE = −T/(2E). The field-free map is Δt_out = Δt_in + gΔE; the energy deviation is conserved.
en.bunch_step3_body: σ²_out = σ²_t + g²σ²_E + 2g Cov(t,E). The covariance term can reduce or increase the time width. Near cancellation, second-order terms must be checked.
en.scan_title: Watch one parameter move the operating point
en.scan_intro: The animation reveals already-calculated scan points in order. Each point has its own ideal Mathieu classification; changing playback speed does not change the calculation.
en.scan_use: Use the highlighted value in the shared operating point
en.scan_preset_note: These presets change the selected scan parameter and its range. Applying a highlighted point changes the shared input used by the other RFQ tabs.
en.scan_law_voltage: At fixed mass, radius and frequency: q ∝ V and D_RF ∝ V². The DC Mathieu parameter a stays fixed when U stays fixed.
en.scan_law_frequency: At fixed voltage, mass and radius: a, q and D_RF scale as f_RF⁻². Frequency can therefore move a point across a stability boundary.
en.scan_law_radius: At fixed voltage, mass and frequency: a, q and D_RF scale as r₀⁻². A smaller aperture strengthens the ideal field but also changes the physical acceptance, which is not computed here.
en.scan_law_mass: At fixed voltage, charge, radius and frequency: a, q and D_RF scale as m⁻¹. This is an ideal stability comparison, not a mass-resolution or transmission spectrum.
en.scan_model_note: Classification uses ideal Mathieu stability at every point. D_RF = zVq/4 is an RF-only, low-q pseudopotential estimate at r₀; it excludes DC and is not a stability criterion.
en.scan_step1_body: Only the selected physical parameter changes across the supplied scan. RF amplitudes always refer to the peak on one rod.
en.scan_step2_body: The same definitions and voltage convention are used at every point. Marker colour and shape identify the independently calculated classification.
en.scan_step3_body: Pause or scrub to a highlighted value, then apply it to the shared operating point. Follow its consequences in the motion, cooling and bunch views without interpreting stability as efficiency.
en.gas_frame_note: Mean-energy relaxation proxy; no collision trajectories or RF heating.
en.gas_pdf_frame_note: Assumed 3D Maxwell profiles; each peak = 1. The model supplies only the mean.
en.bunch_beamline_short: Given source covariance; no extraction-field calculation.
en.bunch_contour_short: Covariance contour: radius 2 (86.5% for a 2D Gaussian).
en.bunch_projection_short: Gaussian profiles: each peak = 1; heights are not ion counts.
en.bunch_frame_note: First-order field-free drift. Contours are not ion tracks; extraction values are expectations.
en.scan_frame_note: Ideal Mathieu classification. RF-only depth is a low-q approximation; no transmission prediction.

zh.frame_note: 解析教学画面 · 非实测数据
zh.gas_intro: 观察平均能量以及初始非平衡偏差还剩多少。游标始终显示真实的模型驻留时间。
zh.gas_deviation: 初始非平衡偏差剩余量
zh.gas_time_note: 早期弛豫模式采用非均匀播放节奏；画面标出的时间与模型数值仍为物理量。
zh.gas_pdf_toggle: 显示假设的 Maxwell 能量分布
zh.gas_pdf_axis: 概率密度 / 各自峰值
zh.gas_pdf_assumption: 附加示意假设：每一帧都采用三维 Maxwell 能量分布，并令 kT_eff = 2⟨E⟩/3。弛豫模型只计算平均能量，并未证明分布具有这种形状。 两条曲线各自归一化为峰值 1；对数间隔的能量轴仍标出物理能量。
zh.gas_pdf_zero: 平均能量为零时，理想分布是 δ 函数，不能画成具有有限宽度的曲线。
zh.gas_zero_rate: 没有弛豫：气压或能量传递效率为零，平均能量保持初值。
zh.gas_at_equilibrium: 初始平均能量已经等于热平衡能量。
zh.gas_model_note: 均匀气体中的平均能量指数弛豫，采用固定的初始相对速度估计。此画面不计算单次碰撞、射频加热或透射率。
zh.gas_step1_body: n = p/(kBT)，ν = nσv_rel。在此模型中提高气压会提高碰撞机会率，而截面和相对速度采用给定值。
zh.gas_step2_title: 2. 碰撞时间不等于弛豫时间
zh.gas_step2_body: 能量传递因子为 2mM/(m+M)²，再乘以输入的效率。经过多次碰撞，平均能量才可能变化一个弛豫尺度。
zh.gas_step3_title: 3. 平均能量趋近热平衡值
zh.gas_step3_body: 初始能量偏差按 exp(−t/τ) 衰减。一个 τ 后剩余 36.8%，五个 τ 后剩余 0.674%。实际射频加热会改变平衡，但未包含在此模型中。
zh.bunch_title: 观察时间—能量相关的剪切
zh.bunch_intro: 让观测面沿无场漂移段移动。能量较高的离子更早到达，因此初始正时间—能量相关可压缩时间投影。
zh.bunch_projection_title: 同一时间尺度上的投影
zh.bunch_beamline_note: 示意图：出口协方差由输入给定，不求解引出波形或边缘场。
zh.bunch_contour_note: 椭圆表示协方差轮廓，不是离子轨迹。所画半径为 2 的轮廓在二维高斯假设下包含 86.5% 的概率。漂移映射为 Δt → Δt + gΔE，ΔE 保持不变。
zh.bunch_projection_note: 两条高斯投影共用时间轴，并各自归一化为峰值 1。宽度来自一阶协方差模型，曲线高度不代表离子数。
zh.bunch_preset_note: 压缩案例令 ρ = +0.95，并选择使该相关条件下一阶宽度最小的漂移距离；展宽案例令 ρ = −0.85，其余源参数保持当前输入。
zh.bunch_near_focus: 接近一阶时间焦点：被忽略的二阶漂移展宽已经显著。很窄的一阶轮廓不等于经过验证的探测峰。
zh.bunch_large_spread: 能散超过线性化筛查范围。当前画面只能作为形式上的一阶示意。
zh.bunch_degenerate: 零宽度投影画成 δ 线；模型没有补入有限源宽度或高阶效应。
zh.bunch_inventory_note: 这些数值来自独立的积累/损失模型和输入的引出比例，不代表空间电荷或脉冲引出轨迹计算。
zh.bunch_step1_body: 输入标准差和相关系数给出 Cov(t,E) = ρ σt σE。正相关表示较晚的离子倾向于具有较高能量。
zh.bunch_step2_body: 平均能量为 E、飞行时间为 T 时，g = dT/dE = −T/(2E)。无场映射为 Δt_out = Δt_in + gΔE，能量偏差守恒。
zh.bunch_step3_body: σ²_out = σ²_t + g²σ²_E + 2g Cov(t,E)。协方差项可缩小或增大时间宽度。在近相消区域，必须检查二阶项。
zh.scan_title: 观察一个参数如何移动工作点
zh.scan_intro: 动画按顺序显示已经计算好的扫描点。每一点都有独立的理想 Mathieu 稳定性分类，播放速度不改变计算结果。
zh.scan_use: 将高亮值应用到共享工作点
zh.scan_preset_note: 预设改变扫描参数及其范围。应用高亮点会改变其他 RFQ 页签共用的输入。
zh.scan_law_voltage: 固定质量、半径与频率时，q ∝ V，D_RF ∝ V²。若 U 不变，直流 Mathieu 参数 a 保持不变。
zh.scan_law_frequency: 固定电压、质量与半径时，a、q 和 D_RF 均按 f_RF⁻² 缩放，因此改变频率可能跨越稳定性边界。
zh.scan_law_radius: 固定电压、质量与频率时，a、q 和 D_RF 均按 r₀⁻² 缩放。缩小孔径会增强理想场，也会改变此处未计算的物理接收度。
zh.scan_law_mass: 固定电压、电荷数、半径与频率时，a、q 和 D_RF 均按 m⁻¹ 缩放。这是理想稳定性比较，不是质量分辨率或透射谱。
zh.scan_model_note: 每个点均采用理想 Mathieu 稳定性判定。D_RF = zVq/4 是 r₀ 处低 q 近似下的纯射频赝势估计，排除直流作用，也不是稳定性判据。
zh.scan_step1_body: 扫描中只改变选定物理参数。射频幅度始终表示一根杆上的零到峰值。
zh.scan_step2_title: 2. 重新计算 a 和 q
zh.scan_step2_body: 每个点采用相同定义和电压约定。标记的颜色和形状表示独立计算得到的稳定性分类。
zh.scan_step3_title: 3. 选择一个工作点继续研究
zh.scan_step3_body: 暂停或拖动进度到某个高亮值，再应用到共享工作点。继续观察运动、冷却与束团结果，并将稳定性与效率区分开。
zh.gas_frame_note: 平均能量弛豫近似；不计算碰撞轨迹或射频加热。
zh.gas_pdf_frame_note: 假设三维 Maxwell 分布，各峰值为 1。模型只提供平均能量。
zh.bunch_beamline_short: 给定源协方差；不计算引出电场。
zh.bunch_contour_short: 协方差轮廓：半径 2（二维高斯概率 86.5%）。
zh.bunch_projection_short: 高斯曲线各峰值为 1，高度不表示离子数。
zh.bunch_frame_note: 一阶无场漂移。轮廓不是离子轨迹；引出数值是期望值。
zh.scan_frame_note: 理想 Mathieu 分类；纯射频阱深采用低 q 近似，不预测透射率。
